services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: The Escape is a SeaArk 54. She is 54' long x 14' wide, has 11 tables onboard, is covered to provide shelter from the elements, is equipped with a head (restroom), and is most commonly used for our private charters. All prices are starting rates. Gratuity not included. A customary tip is at least 20%. We welcomed the Second Nature to our fleet in the late season of 2021. She was custom built by Sarasota Bay Boat Company, is 17' x 64' long, has an upper and lower deck, and is equipped with 2 marine heads (restrooms). services.name: Public Cruises
services.desc: Ed Shockley is a musician, singer, and songwriter born in Lewes. Starting his first band at 13, his musical career eventually took him to Manhattan where he spent the largest part of his adult life. As a drummer and singer, Ed has appeared on scores of records, TV, and radio commercials and concerts. Writing and recording original music has been his main focus, releasing over 14 albums and CDs throughout his career. Since moving back to Lewes in 2005, Ed has formed several bands, each with a distinct musical personality: The Funsters, Vinyl Shockley, The Reminders, Big Hat No Cattle and The Fun Size. services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Your adventure begins from our Anglers Road dock with a cruise on the serene Lewes-Rehoboth Canal, then we’ll sail out into the Delaware Bay to search for DOLPHINS (most likely seen from mid-May to mid to late September) where you will enjoy breathtaking views of local landmarks, including the East End Lighthouse, Cape Henlopen Point, the Lewes Ferry terminal, Lewes Beach, and Cape Henlopen State Park and, of course, the SUNSET. Although the cruise is not fully narrated, it offers an unforgettable visual experience. In the event of unfavorable wind or wave conditions, the cruise will instead explore the calm, sheltered waters of the Broadkill River and/or Lewes-Rehoboth

blurb: Cape Water Tours offers narrated, educational ecology and birding tours, sunset cruises, dolphin watching, and live music cruises. They operate primarily from May through October with some off-season tours. Their boats accommodate groups up to 100 guests and allow bringing your own food and drinks.

quotes.text: The sunset cruise was a blast and the captains were very informative and fun. I loved that we could bring our own drinks and snacks. Would recommend to anyone looking for a fun relaxing evening.
Enjoyed the eco-tour with three teens Each of us learned a few things and enjoyed seeing the landscape from the canal perspective. Definitely recommend as a family activity.
Great tour of the canal. We loved the eco-tour. The staff, both Captain Steve and tour leader Kathleen, were well informed, friendly, and very helpful. We'll do it again!
Our guide was so nice and explained things to us and stayed extra time to view the dolphins. It was a beautiful trip and I'd recommend it to anyone!
